quarterly_data.quarter: VAST Data press release: VAST Data and Hyperfusion Accelerate AI Infrastructure (10-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: VAST Data and UAE-based Hyperfusion announced plans to integrate the VAST AI Operating System into Hyperfusion's Sentinel modular AI infrastructure (a factory-commissioned AI data center in a single container) as its preferred data platform, for sovereign, confidential AI inference; each Sentinel scaling unit is designed around 96 GPUs and approximately two to three petabytes of data capacity.
quarterly_data.figure: 96 GPUs and approximately two to three petabytes per Sentinel scaling unit
